title: Animate Video Headless Engine
description: Create animate/video/rs headless video engine depending on animate_core with VelloRenderer, SceneFileWriter, partial movie cache, render_scene API, script.ts, project.json, package.json, and tests.
summary: Created animate/video/rs headless video engine (animate_video crate) wired to animate_core Scene/Sobject API: VelloRenderer with wgpu offscreen readback and static-layer hash cache, SceneFileWriter with partial PNG sequences + FFmpeg concat (MP4/GIF/last-frame/PNG sequence), PartialMovieCache keyed by frame hash, render_scene() with FrameRecorder timeline capture, script.ts test/render commands, nx project.json/package.json, workspace member + launch.json entries.
